object.attr: derived: Mellon's own documents must be edited with a released build, and the history can then show which build made each agent commit (CF-M3). Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-M6); `git log --grep "Via: mellon-mcp"` still matches.
object.description: When the MCP server makes a commit, the MCP server should give Mellon's version after `mellon-mcp` in the `Via` trailer.
